title: I Was a Leader at the Pentagon. Congress Must Impeach and Remove Pete Hegseth Now
author: Wes J. Bryant - War Analyst
content:

Pete Hegseth's spectacle last Thursday should be enough to warrant his removal
as secretary of defense in and of itself. In a ranting
[video](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/05/us/politics/hegseth-video-midterms-
trump.html) posted on social media in response to reporting on his potential
impeachment, Hegseth once again put his violent extremism, emotional
instability, and psychological volatility on full display as he made direct
overtures threatening the use of the U.S. military against his political
enemies. Or, as he calls them, "the radical Democrats."

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Most of us knew a Hegseth tenure would be catastrophic. Now, a year and a half
in, it's been far worse than I predicted in March last year when I publicly
blew the whistle on his unlawful
[dismantling](https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-
security/2025/03/04/trump-hegseth-pentagon-firings-civilian-
harm/?fbclid=IwY2xjawI2nv9leHRuA2FlbQIxMQABHS5sj5M6CpU_s2kbZOwXWQrhALQDLEYw5dm0qcmc4NqqbdYiG50UCjORUA_aem_CvGGm_WdV_G0N-zbJxufPA)
of the Pentagon's civilian protection center, where I served as chief of
civilian harm assessments, and raised
[alarms](https://www.bostonglobe.com/2025/03/04/opinion/trump-hegseth-
pentagon-diversity-military/) about his ideology and character.

With [Pete Hegseth](https://zeteo.com/p/secretary-of-war-crimes-pete-hegseth)
at the helm of the most powerful military in history, under the free rein
given to him by Donald Trump, the United States has come to embody far-right
fascism and the pursuit of global
[domination](https://www.whitehouse.gov/releases/2026/09/president-trump-at-
the-united-nations-while-others-have-talked-i-have-acted/) - economically,
politically, and militarily.

While Hegseth's proclaimed
[mantra](https://media.defense.gov/2026/Jan/23/2003864773/-1/-1/0/2026-national-
defense-strategy.pdf) has been "Peace through Strength," the reality played
out before the world has been _Submission through Tyranny_. Under this
administration, the United States has sought nothing less than submission -
from our adversaries, from our allies, and from the American people, with
Hegseth wielding the U.S. military as his primary instrument of enforcement.

Pete Hegseth sounds and acts on the principles of the fascist military despots
of history: totalitarian control; extremist nationalism rooted in religious,
racial, and gender supremacy; and hyper-militarism. He is an
[ideologue](https://www.npr.org/2024/11/14/nx-s1-5191941/pete-hegseth-defense-
department-dei) who has sought to inject white Christian nationalism into the
fabric of the armed forces - a worldview that is to pure Christianity what
ISIS or the Taliban's version of Sharia law is to Islam, and that is
fundamentally discriminatory against women, minorities, and the LGBTQ+
community. This is evident not only in his hateful rhetoric, but in his
erasure of institutional history and his purging of senior military leaders -
[overwhelmingly](https://www.cfr.org/reports/the-war-on-military-talent) made
up of women and minorities - who fail his ideological litmus tests.

Hegseth's extremism is also infused with a juvenile obsession with [hyper-
masculinity](https://theintercept.com/2026/07/25/pete-hegseth-testosterone-
military-masculinity/). It is the same phenomenon paralleled across the far
right in a movement that many refer to as the MAGA "[manosphere](https://gnet-
research.org/2024/11/20/the-trump-manosphere-reactionary-male-supremacy-
misogyny-and-accelerationist-violence-in-the-post-election-era/)," but
amplified. In no small way, Hegseth's obsession with U.S. troop masculinity is
reminiscent of the Aryan movement of the Third Reich. It is a mirror image of
Hitler's efforts to proliferate the
[archetype](https://nazigermany.lmu.build/exhibits/show/sauerwald/introduction)
of Nazi Germany's "New German Man."

His ideology is rooted in dehumanization and an
[obsession](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/03/12/briefing/pete-hegseths-
rhetoric-of-violence.html) with performative violence. This is even more
dangerous when combined with his bloodlust and glorification of war. Under his
so-called "lethality [doctrine](https://www.stimson.org/2025/the-perils-of-
lethality/)," he reduces the profound mission of the U.S. military solely to
unbridled destruction, demonstrating an open
[contempt](https://www.justsecurity.org/135468/dangers-of-hegseths-warfighter-
ethos/) for the laws of war, the Geneva Conventions, and the rules of
engagement meant to enforce them. Accordingly, he and his boss, Donald Trump,
have sidelined or removed anyone standing in defense of the rule of law - from
combatant [commanders](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/military-leaders-fired-
forced-out-resigned-hegseth-defense-secretary-trump-pentagon/) to senior
military [lawyers](https://www.nytimes.com/2025/02/22/us/politics/hegseth-
firings-military-lawyers-jag.html) to service chiefs and even the chairman of
the Joint Chiefs.

[Share](https://zeteo.com/p/i-worked-at-the-pentagon-
congress?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&action=share)

Hegseth talks emphatically about "reviving the warrior
[ethos](https://www.war.gov/News/Speeches/Speech/article/4616486/secretary-of-
war-pete-hegseths-state-of-the-force-address-as-delivered/)" in the U.S.
military. But his version is a juvenile fixation on masculinity coupled with
undisciplined killing. It is an ethos directly opposed to the one I lived as a
U.S. special operator hunting America's enemies during the so-called "War on
Terror." Restraint, temperance, humanity, honor - these are the virtues that
separate the professional warrior from the lawless killer. The U.S. military's
own [Law](https://media.defense.gov/2023/Jul/31/2003271432/-1/-1/0/dod-law-of-
war-manual-june-2015-updated-july%202023.pdf) of War manual establishes that
humanity and honor form the bedrock of the warfighter's profession. These are
the principles that distinguish us from the adversaries we fight. Hegseth
demonstrates none of them.

Upon taking office, Hegseth [signaled](https://www.war.gov/News/News-
Stories/Article/Article/4295826/trump-renames-dod-to-department-of-war/) his
intentions by, with the backing of the president, attempting to rebrand the
Department of Defense as the "Department of War" along with his own title. War
is what he wanted, and war is what he'll continue to pursue as long as he is
in the seat.

In [violation](https://theharvardpoliticalreview.com/hegseth-war-on-
peace-2/#google_vignette) of domestic law, international treaties, and the [UN
Charter](https://www.justsecurity.org/135423/professors-letter-international-
law-iran-war/), the U.S. military has conducted cross-border
[raids](https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/analysis-opinion/no-legal-
basis-invading-venezuela) in Venezuela and abducted its head of state,
executed an expanded strike campaign in [Yemen](https://trump-
yemen.airwars.org/operation-rough-rider) that resulted in staggering civilian
casualty rates, and waged a reckless war in
[Iran](https://www.justsecurity.org/137669/60-day-mark-iran-war-triply-
illegal/) that inflicted [catastrophic](https://airwars.org/conflicts/israeli-
iranian-and-us-forces-2026) civilian
[harm](https://www.americanprogress.org/article/the-human-and-environmental-
costs-of-the-war-in-iran/) and committed unequivocal [war
crimes](https://news.un.org/en/story/2026/09/1168358) without any
accountability. Simultaneously, this administration continues to carry out
[extrajudicial
killings](https://www.ohchr.org/sites/default/files/documents/issues/terrorism/sr-
ct-briefing-note-targeting-narco-terrori.pdf) under the pretext of
"narcoterrorism" - a designation unsupported both legally and per military
[doctrine](https://zeteo.com/p/cartels-are-bad-but-theyre-not-terrorists) -
while expanding special operations footprints across [Latin
America](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/14/us/politics/us-troops-latin-
america.html) and [Africa](https://www.orfonline.org/expert-speak/africom-
under-the-trump-administration).

Equally alarming is what Hegseth is executing at home. He has initiated a
dangerous synthesis of federal military force with domestic policing
operations. He has directed troop
[deployments](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/pete-hegseth-los-angeles-protest-
national-guard-marines/) within predominantly Democratic American cities to
reinforce immigration operations and intimidate lawful protesters. He has
[expanded](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/11/05/hegseth-expands-d-c-
national-guard-presence-01151398) armed troop presence in our nation's capital
and at the southern [border](https://time.com/7308904/dc-national-guard-trump-
troops/). Most chillingly, he has
[positioned](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/trump-threatens-to-use-
insurrection-act-to-put-down-protests-in-minneapolis) the military for
mobilization against American citizens under the Insurrection Act and has
[overseen](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-
politics/national-guard-rapid-response-forces-hegseth-trump-b2855190.html) the
establishment of National Guard "Quick Reaction Forces" across all 50 U.S.
states intended for domestic use.

In just over a year, America's military has become an engine of domestic
intimidation and unchecked foreign aggression. America is now embracing the
hallmarks of an oppressive police state, carrying out a neo-imperialist
crusade of global military domination while threatening civilizational
[annihilation](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2026/04/iran-president-
trumps-apocalyptic-threats-of-large-scale-civilian-devastation-demand-urgent-
global-action-to-prevent-atrocity-crimes/), and
[threatening](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/08/18/us/politics/trumps-upside-
down-world.html) allies while aiding, abetting, and even
[conspiring](https://www.cfr.org/articles/trumps-russian-diesel-deal-
explained) with our longest-standing adversaries. Under Pete Hegseth, the
United States military has been hijacked to do the bidding of tyranny.

congress?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&action=share)

Validating the whistleblowing for which I continue to face retaliation, the
Defense Department's own inspector general
[determined](https://www.amnestyusa.org/press-releases/inspector-generals-
report-finds-pentagon-is-violating-u-s-law-by-failing-to-prevent-civilian-
harm/) that Hegseth's dismantling of civilian protection mechanisms violated
federal law and caused systemic failures to safeguard noncombatants. His
warmongering has also opened a Pandora's Box of
[multiregional](https://www.cfr.org/global-conflict-
tracker/conflict/confrontation-between-united-states-and-iran) conflict and
caused a global energy [crisis](https://www.wri.org/iran-war),
disproportionately [harmed](https://news.un.org/en/story/2026/03/1167138)
civilians, alienated strategic allies, and cost American [service
members](https://www.newsweek.com/iran-war-us-military-death-toll-rises-
to-23-as-airmans-death-investigated-12639119) their lives - all while
depleting [readiness](https://militaryspend.org/iran-war-casualties),
hollowing out critical munitions
[stockpiles](https://www.cnn.com/2026/07/29/politics/us-weapons-stockpiles-
dwindle-iran-war), and putting our vulnerabilities on full display to foreign
adversaries.

I have always believed that America's posture on the world stage should be
founded in benevolence and should reflect our highest principles. The U.S.
military was established to be not only _of_ the people but _for_ the people
and to uphold the sacred ideals that Americans hold dear: to protect the
innocent, to defend freedom, to liberate the oppressed, to stand for humanity.
Under Hegseth, the U.S. military has been exploited to portray an America that
is everything I swore an oath to stand against.

It is time for our nation to remember what we stand for. Pete Hegseth presents
a clear and present danger to our democracy, our armed forces, and the world.
His extremism, violent volatility, contempt for the rule of law, and his
willingness to turn the weapons of war onto the American people make him unfit
for command.

He should never have been confirmed, and Congress should have acted long ago.

In September, Republican Rep. Thomas Massie
[introduced](https://massie.house.gov/news/documentsingle.aspx?DocumentID=395853)
eight articles of impeachment against Pete Hegseth, and just today
[reintroduced](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f8ZG_MiLc0I) them on the House
floor. The constitutional imperative is urgent: Pete Hegseth must be
immediately impeached and removed, indicted for war crimes, and held
accountable for high crimes against the Constitution and the American people.

If Congress doesn't have the backbone or the will to defend this Republic, the
American people must demand it. And I will be more than willing to lead that
charge.

 _**Wes J. Bryant** is a former senior targeting adviser and policy analyst at

[Hunting the Caliphate](https://www.amazon.com/Hunting-Caliphate-Americas-
